This template is to be used for citing individual pages on ''[[Rocket League]]''{{'}}s [https://www.rocketleague.com official website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below, and paste it into an article's reference note. Fill in as many parameters as you can, remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{RocketLeague|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://www.rocketleague.com/</nowiki></code>).
*{{Para|text}} Name of the page being cited.

{{BackupLinkHelp}}

===Example(s)===
<code><nowiki>{{RocketLeague|url=en/news/may-the-4th-be-with-you-in-rocket-league-celebrate-star-wars-day-2024|text=May the 4th Be with You in Rocket League - Celebrate Star Wars Day 2024|archivedate=20240618015742}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{RocketLeague|url=en/news/may-the-4th-be-with-you-in-rocket-league-celebrate-star-wars-day-2024|text=May the 4th Be with You in Rocket League - Celebrate Star Wars Day 2024|archivedate=20240618015742}}
